purpose: Target intonation-shape statistics for Nalu Luna narration. Derived from CEO-selected reference narration (신비한건축사전 6 shorts). INTONATION STATISTICS ONLY — no voice cloning, no audio reuse. Luna timbre stays CANDIDATE_B (B_voiced_spectral_micro_smooth.wav, sha 30C6D34...).

provenance.method: yt-dlp bestaudio -> demucs htdemucs two-stem vocal separation -> scripts/analyze_prosody_v1.py (adaptive Otsu VAD, librosa pyin F0, semitone normalization to speaker voiced median)
provenance.reference_audio_retention: downloaded full mixes deleted after measurement; separated narration stems kept only in session scratchpad until gate validation, then deleted; never used as synthesis input or in any published output
provenance.comparison_corpus: PASS = MW-MESH-001 rebuild_v1.3_final_selected (uploaded video). FAIL = SUBSEA-001 + SPIDER-001 luna_natural_v2 (CEO: intonation broken, unreleasable).

normalization: all pitch values in semitones (st) relative to the file's own voiced-median F0; slopes in st/s. Comparable across different narrator voices.

breath_unit_duration_s.note: REF speaks in short punchy phrases. Luna FAIL median 3.12s, PASS 2.92s — both ~2x too long. Normalizer must split scripts into ~4-22 syllable phrases (median ~10 syllables).

pause_s.note: 8/13 Luna FAIL blocks had ZERO internal pauses. Assembler inserts pauses at phrase boundaries, jittered within [p25,p75], occasionally up to p90.

syllable_rate_hz.note: proxy = librosa onset rate inside speech. Luna FAIL 5.78 — too slow. Gate + retake below 5.8.

unit_pitch_range_st.note: Luna already in range (9.4-9.7). Keep as sanity bound only: reject < 5 (monotone) or > 14 (performative).

end_slope_st_s.note: continuation-vs-final split showed NO difference (both med -11.7) — single distribution, wide. Luna FAIL was too shallow AND too uniform (-7.2 med). Per-unit gate: [-35, +8]. Block-level: median of unit slopes must land in [-20,-5].

unit_reset_st.note: pitch of next unit start minus prev unit end. Luna FAIL erratic (file medians 2.1-8.9). Gate keeps continuity without imposing artificial declination.

declination_st_per_unit.note: HYPOTHESIS REFUTED: reference shorts narration has NO paragraph declination (~0). Do NOT impose synthetic declination. Luna FAIL erratic (-0.72..+0.30) — fix via reset gate, not declination shaping.

non_differentiators.ioi_cv: REF 0.36 vs Luna 0.33-0.35 — overlapping, dropped from gating
non_differentiators.pause_duration_median: similar 0.27-0.34 — pause EXISTENCE is the differentiator, not length

ceo_validated_assembly_2026_08_05.verdict: B(phrase pipeline) > A(block synthesis) on SUBSEA B04 A/B; then pause ladder B0>B1>B2>B3>B4 — CEO picked B4: '너무 좋다, 어긋남 안들려'
ceo_validated_assembly_2026_08_05.note: measured REF pause stats (med 0.27s) OVERSTATE mid-sentence pauses: VAD only counted gaps>=0.15s, and inserted digital silence reads longer than natural gaps. Sentence-final band from REF held up. Phrase edges keep 30ms trim pad + 12ms fades, so 0s insertion still leaves ~60ms natural separation.
ceo_validated_assembly_2026_08_05.gate_activity_evidence: caught 2 rising-end takes (+28,+31 st/s) and 1 slow take (3.74 syl/s) on B04; number phrases (천팔백...) run slow across ALL takes -> relax rate gate for numeral-heavy phrases instead of rejecting
